title: A gentle answer
text: A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.

title: Slow to anger
text: A wrathful man stirs up contention, but one who is slow to anger appeases strife.

title: Seek wise counsel
text: Where there is no counsel, plans fail; but in a multitude of counselors they are established.

title: Listen first
text: So, then, my beloved brothers, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, and slow to anger;

title: Words that build up
text: Let no corrupt speech proceed out of your mouth, but only what is good for building others up as the need may be, that it may give grace to those who hear.

title: Kindness and forgiveness
text: And be kind to one another, tender hearted, forgiving each other, just as God also in Christ forgave you.

title: Compassion and humility
text: Put on therefore, as God’s chosen ones, holy and beloved, a heart of compassion, kindness, lowliness, humility, and perseverance;

title: Don't discourage your child
text: Fathers, don’t provoke your children, so that they won’t be discouraged.

title: Carry one another's burdens
text: Bear one another’s burdens, and so fulfill the law of Christ.

title: Persevere in doing good
text: Let’s not be weary in doing good, for we will reap in due season if we don’t give up.

title: Love is patient and kind
text: Love is patient and is kind. Love doesn’t envy. Love doesn’t brag, is not proud,

title: Seek peace where possible
text: If it is possible, as much as it is up to you, be at peace with all men.

title: Peacemakers
text: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they shall be called children of God.

title: Patient guidance
text: Train up a child in the way he should go, and when he is old he will not depart from it.
